annotation.title_clean: Socially interactive industrial robots: a PAD model of flow for emotional co-regulation
annotation.title_en: Socially interactive industrial robots: a PAD model of flow for emotional co-regulation
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Nunnari, F.; Tsovaltzi, D.; Lavit Nicora, M.; Beyrodt, S.; Prajod, P.; Chehayeb, L.; et al.
annotation.summary_en: Technical and empirical paper from the EU MindBot project presenting a cobot plus avatar ("covatar") and the BASSF emotion model, using Pleasure-Arousal-Dominance signals to co-regulate worker emotions and support flow in industrial assembly. Two user studies (N=20, N=12) support the model. It has no explicit governance content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Proposes BASSF, a transparent theory-based model of boredom, anxiety, self-efficacy, self-compassion and flow.
Raw PAD signals are noisy and need pre-filtering and per-user calibration.
Study 1 finds Dominance predicts self-efficacy and flow.
Study 2 supports socially interactive cobots for worker wellbeing and job satisfaction.
Stresses explainability of system interventions in worker-facing cobots.
